T: Welcome to Earth. Welcome to dinner.
D: A ragtag group of humans fights back against invading aliens on the 4th of July.
P: Serve the mains when the President gives his big speech.
S: Potatoes sliced 1.5mm on a mandoline, rinsed and dried, fried at 170C in batches, tossed in salt and a little green chilli powder.
Popcorn tossed in melted white chocolate, then scattered with red and blue sprinkles and popping candy before it sets.

Topside sliced thin and marinated in soy, Worcestershire, brown sugar, chilli and smoked paprika, slow-dried until chewy and smoky. Freeze 800g topside for 1 hour, then slice 3mm thick across the grain. Mix 100ml soy sauce, 2 tbsp Worcestershire, 2 tbsp brown sugar, 2 tsp chilli flakes and 2 tsp smoked paprika. Marinate the beef overnight in the fridge. Pat dry and lay on wire racks over trays. Dry at 70C with the oven door slightly open for 4 hours until leathery but still bendy. Cool and store airtight.
M: Pork ribs rubbed with paprika, brown sugar and garlic, wrapped and baked at 150C for 2.5 hours, unwrapped and glazed under a hot grill. Charred corn, potato salad with mustard dressing.
W: Vanilla slab cake covered in whipped cream, blueberries in the top corner for stars, rows of halved strawberries for stripes.
K: Bourbon stirred into fresh lemonade with crushed strawberries and blueberries, poured over ice in mason jars with a lemon wheel and mint. Make lemonade by stirring 150ml fresh lemon juice and 120ml sugar syrup into 500ml cold water. Lightly crush 100g strawberries and 50g blueberries in the bottom of 4 jars. Fill with ice, add 45ml bourbon to each and top with the lemonade. Stir and garnish with a lemon wheel and mint sprig.

s.how: Slice 600g potatoes 1.5mm thick on a mandoline, rinse and dry well. Fry at 170C in batches until golden and crisp. Toss with fine salt and a little green chilli powder while hot.

Pop 100g kernels and spread on a lined tray. Drizzle over 150g melted white chocolate and toss gently. Scatter with red and blue sprinkles and 2 packets of popping candy before it sets. Break into clusters.

m.how: Rub 1.5kg pork ribs with 2 tbsp brown sugar, 1 tbsp smoked paprika and garlic. Wrap and bake at 150C for 2.5 hours, then unwrap and glaze under a hot grill. Char 4 corn cobs. Toss 1kg boiled potatoes with Dijon, oil and vinegar.

w.how: Put a slab sponge cake on a board. Whip 600ml cream with 2 tbsp icing sugar and spread over the top. Fill the top left corner with 125g blueberries for stars, and lay rows of halved strawberries, 500g in total, for stripes.

d.how: Make lemonade by stirring 150ml fresh lemon juice and 120ml sugar syrup into 500ml cold water. Lightly crush 100g strawberries and 50g blueberries in the bottom of 4 jars. Fill with ice, add 45ml bourbon to each and top with the lemonade. Stir and garnish with a lemon wheel and mint sprig.
